description: This Java source file defines the TextHandler class, which is a component implementing the ComplexObsHandler interface for managing complex observation data as text files within the OpenMRS system. It handles reading and saving textual or stream-based complex data associated with medical observations, primarily storing data to and retrieving data from the file system, with support for multiple views (text, raw, URI).

classes.name: TextHandler
classes.description: A Spring-managed component class that handles storing and retrieving complex text-based observation data, supporting different views and ensuring proper file handling within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs an Obs object containing complex data based on the specified view (text, raw, URI), reading from the storage service.

methods.name: getSupportedViews
methods.description: Returns the supported views for displaying complex data: text, raw, and URI.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves complex data from an Obs object to the file system and updates the Obs with the data's title and URI, removing the complex data after saving.
